cards.title: Men and women in admissions

headline.caption: of colleges admit women at a notably higher rate than men

cards.sentence: In fall 2004, 13% of colleges admitted men at a rate 3 or more points higher than women; in fall 2024, 6% did, while 48% favored women by as much.

series.name: Women admitted at a higher rate
Men admitted at a higher rate

cards.title: Shrinking colleges

headline.caption: of colleges have at least 10% fewer undergraduates than ten years ago

cards.sentence: Across 1,537 colleges, 51% have at least 10% fewer undergraduates than in fall 2014, while 23% grew that much; the median college's undergraduate count fell 11%.

series.name: Smaller than at the window's start

cards.title: Public colleges and students from other states

headline.caption: median public college's out-of-state share of first-years

cards.sentence: The median public college's out-of-state share rose from 11% in fall 2014 to 13% in fall 2024, and the share of publics that are 30%+ out-of-state rose from 17% to 22%.
